website.note: Pipeline page at /our-science/#pipeline; per-asset pages list RLYB116, RLYB332, RLYB114

pipeline.modality: Engineered Affibody-ABD fusion protein (subcutaneous, expressed in E. coli)
pipeline.license_origin: In-licensed from Sobi (Swedish Orphan Biovitrum, March 2019); Affibody platform license

indications.indication: Complement-mediated diseases (pipeline-in-a-product; planned indications include platelet transfusion refractoriness and antiphospholipid syndrome)
indications.trial_design: Single-blind multiple-ascending-dose Phase 1 in healthy volunteers; 4-week dosing, 10-week follow-up; two cohorts of 8 (6 active : 2 placebo)
indications.trial_status: Completed (Feb 2026); achieved tolerability and complete sustained terminal complement inhibition
key_milestones: Two completed Phase 1 trials (SAD and confirmatory MAD)

excluded_preclinical: RLYB332 — long-acting anti-MTP-2 monoclonal antibody for severe anemia / ineffective erythropoiesis / iron overload (preclinical, ASH 2024 poster)
RLYB331 — original (short half-life) anti-MTP-2 antibody (preclinical, succeeded by RLYB332)
RLYB114 — second C5-targeting Affibody-derived asset from Sobi (preclinical)
excluded_legacy_terminated: RLYB212 — anti-HPA-1a monoclonal antibody for FNAIT prevention; Phase 2 PK/safety trial (NCT06435845) terminated; company announced discontinuation of RLYB212 development in April 2025
